test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Introducing Deveshi to the guests, Ashish said, “Her father is the only son of my paternal grandfather’s only son”. How is Ashish related to Deveshi ?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20f8e463dec121ef2127ecd0e3d8451f6c05cbd529fd1b01640f5ba2298ffef.png] 

Her (Deveshi's) father is the only son of my (Ashish's) paternal grandfather’s only son, implies Ashish is father of Deveshi. Thus, the final family tree is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c10a115ff1a6f7e658d1e81b9a1c659dae687129929722c334db497fd678b25.png] 

Hence, Ashish is the **father** of Deveshi.
